title: China holds at least one craft, via Puthoff

tellings.quote: China is like a closed door I know through how put up that they have at least one and I think he might have gotten that officially through some work he did with the DIA

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a scientist named Eric Davis says that China has at least one recovered craft of unknown, possibly non-human origin, though he calls China a closed door. Davis says he heard this from a physicist he works with, Hal Puthoff, who he thinks may have learned it officially through work for the DIA, the US military's own intelligence agency. If true, it would mean the US is not the only country holding such objects.
